old_caption: The video captures an intense moment on an outdoor basketball court. A player, dressed in red shorts and black sneakers, is seen manipulating a heavy, textured ball with controlled movements. The camera focuses closely on his lower body, highlighting his stance and the ball's motion near the ground. The court's surface is marked with white lines, indicating the boundaries of the playing area. In the background, a green fence encloses the court, and beyond it, trees and buildings are visible, suggesting an urban setting. The player's tattooed arms and the dynamic motion of his legs suggest a high level of athleticism and focus. The scene conveys a sense of energy and competition, emphasizing the player's dedication to the sport.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures an intense moment on an outdoor basketball court. A player, dressed in red shorts and black sneakers, is seen dribbling a basketball with skillful control. The camera focuses closely on his lower body, highlighting his movements as he maneuvers the ball between his legs. The court's surface is marked with white lines, indicating the boundaries of the playing area. In the background, a green fence encloses the court, and beyond it, trees and buildings are visible, suggesting an urban setting. The player's tattooed arms and the dynamic motion of his legs suggest a high level of athleticism and focus. The scene conveys a sense of energy and competition, emphasizing the player's dedication to the sport.
caption: The video captures a low-angle view of a tattooed player in red shorts and black knee sleeves dribbling on an outdoor court. A green fence, trees, apartment blocks, a hoop, and a parked car sit behind him. The dark basketball is already in motion at the first frame, blurred as it drops near the right hand before leaving the view while the arm keeps pumping. The legs stay spread in a wide stance as the ball re-enters from the right edge and sweeps across toward the left, the reaching hand tracking it. It is then controlled high on the left, pressed by the fingers, before being driven back toward the center and right. The background slides progressively leftward, indicating a tracking pan. The dribbling remains ongoing as the clip ends.

endpoints are normal, not physical errors. Do not add unseen causes, onset, stopping or outcomes.
An internal editing cut is not evidence of physical motion connecting the views.

Check identification before physical interpretation: a reflection is not a separate actor;
a powder/smoke/liquid outline or shadow is not automatically the boundary of a solid object;
an apparent change caused by occlusion/viewpoint is not automatically material deformation.
Do not claim contact, bending, compression, melting, disintegration or structural recovery unless

collision just because the visible configuration would be compatible with it.
Compare several frames before asserting translation, rotation, direction, unchanged position or
camera tracking. A single visible texture/seam does not prove spin. Avoid unnecessary absolute
claims of stillness, no motion, no camera motion or 'exactly' synchronized changes.
Remove invented scene details and explanations, but keep clearly visible ongoing motion and
processes. Avoid deleting the real process merely because its cause lies outside the cropped window.

Retain the WISA English narrative style, detail density and paragraph structure. Aim for the

This is a direct video description, not an analysis note. No mandatory beginning/end formula.
Complete every sentence. If accuracy requires a substantial length difference, explain it outside
the caption; do not fill missing context by imagination. Optional synonym edits are not needed.
